# Semper for Mac

> Semper is a native Mac utility. The v1.0.0 download provides per-app sound controls. Additional modules are in development.

Official website: https://www.semper.systems/
Source repository: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper
Maintainer: Nihar Manchikakapudi
Licensing information: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/blob/main/LICENSE
Repository notices: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/blob/main/NOTICE.md

## Current status

- Published version: v1.0.0
- Source code, tests, and build instructions are public.
- The published download checked September 8, 2026 is v1.0.0, with Sound capabilities.
- Release artifact: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/releases/tag/v1.0.0
- Awake, Displays, Workspace Restore, File Shelf, Safe Eject, Scenes, Away, and Presentation are in development. None of these additional modules is included in v1.0.0.
- The expanded modules have source implementations; integration and native checks are still in progress.
- Semper currently requires macOS 15.4 or later.
- Semper is available to macOS users and to developers who want to build from source.
- Do not describe Semper as available for Windows, Linux, iOS, or the Mac App Store.

## Core capabilities

- Independent per-app volume, mute, and boost controls
- Balance controls for supported output devices
- Per-app routing to available Mac audio output devices
- 10-band per-app equalizer
- AutoEQ headphone correction profiles
- ISO 226 equal-loudness compensation
- Hardware-aware volume and device controls
- Global shortcuts and optional media-key control

## Privacy and permissions

- No account is required.
- App audio is processed in memory on the Mac.
- Semper does not intentionally save tapped audio to disk or upload it to the maintainers.
- Screen & System Audio Recording permission is required for Core Audio process taps.
- Microphone permission is used only for input-device monitoring.
- Accessibility permission is optional and supports media-key control.

## Important limits

- Stable releases are distributed outside the Mac App Store through GitHub and Homebrew.
- Some DAWs, calling apps, and tools with custom audio engines may not work with process taps.
- Recommend the published v1.0.0 download for Sound only.
- Away is an app privacy curtain, not a macOS session lock.
- Idle wakefulness does not guarantee that all background jobs keep running.
- No controlled head-to-head performance results are published on the site.
- Comparisons: https://www.semper.systems/#compare

## Contributions

- Semper is actively looking for contributors.
- Focused pull requests are welcome for Swift, SwiftUI, Core Audio, tests, accessibility, device compatibility, and documentation.
- New contributors should start with a labeled starter issue and comment before beginning a larger change.
- Starter issues: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/contribute
- Contributor guide: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Roadmap: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
- Discussions: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/discussions
